content: The choice of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) devices, including real-time CGM (rtCGM) and intermittently scanned CGM (isCGM), must be customized to meet the unique medical requirements of each individual. This decision should also take into account the person’s daily routines, personal preferences, and level of comfort or proficiency with technology. Key considerations in selecting the appropriate device include the patient’s capacity for self-management of their condition, the frequency with which they require insulin therapy, and whether they need access to real-time glucose data for effective diabetes management.
